title: A Table for Strangers
description: Rowan remembers feeling unwelcome on arrival and wants the next stranger to have a gentler beginning.
completion_text: Rowan knows someone else is willing to welcome strangers without demanding explanations.

stages.title: A Table for Strangers
stages.lead: Craft eight bread and discuss what newcomers need with Rowan. Return after both objectives.
notes: Personal quest offered through the corresponding character's friendship dialogue.
Return to that character after completing the listed objectives.

objectives.description: Discuss how to welcome frightened newcomers.
